features.name: Stiff-String Physical Modeling Voice Engine
features.description: Polyphonic 128-voice physical modeling synthesizer with stiff-string inharmonicity, velocity-dependent hammer hardness, 8-overtone spectrum profile, and strike point shaping.
features.expected_behavior: Generates alias-free stereo floating-point audio across 88+ keys with accurate fundamental frequency, velocity timbre scaling, and zero audio-thread allocations.

features.name: Sympathetic & Duplex Scale Resonance
features.description: String-to-string sympathetic resonance tank amplified when sustain/harmonic pedals are engaged, plus treble duplex shimmer.
features.expected_behavior: Held or undamped strings resonate sympathetically with active notes; slider intensity smoothly scales resonance energy.

features.name: Mechanical Action & Hammer/Damper/Pedal Noises
features.description: Models hammer felt impact noise, damper release thump, key release noise, and sustain pedal mechanical noise.
features.expected_behavior: Audible transient wood/felt components responsive to Hammer Noise, Hammer Tone, Damper Noise, Key Release Noise, and Pedal Noise sliders.

features.name: Tuning, Diapason, Octave Stretching & Historical Temperaments
features.description: Supports A4 Diapason (415-466 Hz), Octave Stretching, Unison Width/Balance, and 8 mathematical temperaments (Equal, Pythagorean, Zarlino, Meantone, Well-Tempered, Werckmeister III, Kirnberger III, Vallotti).
features.expected_behavior: A4 pitch matches Diapason within <0.1 Hz; non-equal temperaments match Section 17 exact frequency ratios.
features.reference_evidence: Manual Sec. 6 & Appendix 17 (pythagore, zarlino, mesotonic, welltempered, werck)

features.name: Pedal State Machine (Sustain, Soft, Sostenuto, Harmonic, Celeste, Buff, Rattle)
features.description: Full pedal state model including half-pedaling sustain, una corda soft felt shift, selective sostenuto latch, harmonic pedal, and historical pedals.
features.expected_behavior: Sustain keeps released notes alive; Sostenuto holds only keys depressed at pedal press; Soft reduces loudness and bright overtones; Harmonic sustains overtones; Rattle adds buzz.
features.test_result: Passed: 5 pedal tests (sustain/reversed, sostenuto, soft, harmonic, rattle)

features.name: PRO Per-Note Edit (Detune, Gain, Hammer Hardness, Impedance)
features.description: Per-MIDI-key physical parameter offsets for micro-tuning and voicing individual notes.
features.expected_behavior: Individual note edits adjust only the targeted MIDI key without mutating global instrument defaults.

features.name: Mallet Bounce Engine
features.description: Zero-allocation fixed-ring multi-hit mallet/key bounce repeater with configurable delay, sync toggle, velocity sensitivity, delay loss, velocity loss, and deterministic humanization jitter.
features.expected_behavior: Enabled bounce triggers decaying repeated strikes spaced by delay_ms * (1 - delay_loss)^k without heap allocation on audio thread.
features.test_result: Passed: test_mallet_bounce_multi_strike_decay + TS geometric decay math test

features.name: Per-Note Effects (LFO Vibrato, Tremolo, Onset & Smear)
features.description: Per-voice LFO phase accumulator (free or phase-locked) driving pitch vibrato, stereo amplitude tremolo, onset duration ramp, attack envelope, and partial frequency smear.
features.expected_behavior: Modulates voice pitch, amplitude envelope, and harmonic smear per-note without artifacts.

features.name: Diatonic Harp 7-Pedal Mode & Guitar Mode
features.description: 7-pedal diatonic harp tuning table (C, D, E, F, G, A, B in flat/natural/sharp) and guitar fret transposition, body resonance scaling, and legato articulation.
features.expected_behavior: Diatonic harp pedals shift target pitch classes by -1/0/+1 semitone; guitar mode transposes by fret and shapes body/legato response.
features.test_result: Passed: test_diatonic_harp_pedals_and_guitar_mode + TS harp mapping contract test

features.name: Multi-Family Physical Instrument Catalog
features.description: 32 calibrated models covering Concert Grands (13), Upright (1), Electric Tines/Reeds/Clavinet/Pianet (5), Historical Harpsichord/Pianoforte (3), Mallets/Steelpan/Kalimba (6), Plucked Guitar/Harp (2), Prepared Grand (1), and Syngular Hybrid (1).
features.expected_behavior: Switching instruments updates exciter physics, string lengths, inharmonicity, decay scales, and default DSP chain.
features.test_result: Passed: 4/4 tests in instruments::tests (32 models, 8 categories, bounds, acoustic differentiation)

features.name: Preset Browser, A/B Morphing & Disk Persistence
features.description: Factory presets per instrument (96 generated across 32 models), continuous A/B parameter morphing slider (including bounce & note_fx), and user JSON preset saving/loading in XDG user data directory.
features.expected_behavior: Morphing smoothly interpolates parameters between Preset A and B; saved presets persist across restarts.

features.name: Real-Time MIDI Input Discovery, Routing & Hot-Plug
features.description: Enumerates Linux ALSA/JACK MIDI ports via midir, parses Note On/Off, CC, Pitch Bend, Aftertouch, Program Change, detects port changes, and connects to active ports.
features.expected_behavior: Connected MIDI controllers trigger notes and pedals in real time without blocking the audio callback.

features.name: Velocity Curve LUT, Transpose, Channel Filter & 61/88/105 Key Modes
features.description: Piecewise-linear velocity remapping, -36..+36 semitone transpose, channel filtering, 16-channel microtonal mode, demo sequence generator, and CC Learn automation.
features.expected_behavior: Velocity curve reshapes soft/hard response; transpose shifts note numbers accurately; CC mappings modulate engine parameters.

features.name: SMF (.mid) File Support, Standalone Player/Recorder & Live CC Learn
features.description: Format 0/1 Standard MIDI File parser/writer, standalone threaded sequence playback with 0.25x..2.0x speed control, performance recording, and 1-click live MIDI CC Learn.
features.expected_behavior: Records and replays MIDI performances at adjustable speed, parses/writes valid .mid files, and captures incoming CCs to bound parameter paths.

features.name: Low-Latency Linux Audio Engine (PipeWire/ALSA/JACK) & Telemetry
features.description: cpal real-time stereo output stream with headless fallback, lock-free command queue, RMS/peak metering, active voice count, latency and CPU telemetry.
features.expected_behavior: Runs smoothly at host sample rate (44.1/48 kHz) without xruns or panics even when audio device is unavailable.

features.name: Offline WAV Export
features.description: Exports deterministic stereo floating-point WAV audio files using hound through the full synthesis + effects pipeline.
features.expected_behavior: Produces valid non-empty RIFF/WAVE files free of NaNs or hard digital clipping.

features.name: 3-Mic Acoustic Stage, Lid Low-Pass Filter, Stereo Width & Binaural ITD Mode
features.description: Virtual microphone positioning with delay/level compensation, 1-pole lid low-pass acoustic attenuation, M/S stereo width, and binaural Woodworth ITD + head-shadow crossfeed.
features.expected_behavior: Closing the lid attenuates upper harmonics; binaural mode + head angle shifts interaural cues; mic compensation scales gain and arrival delay.

features.name: Equalizer, 3 FX Slots (Delay/Chorus/Tremolo/Comp/PEQ), Reverb & Limiter
features.description: Multi-band peaking EQ, 3 configurable DSP effect slots, stereo algorithmic reverb with pre-delay/early reflections/damping/highpass, and soft-knee brickwall limiter.
features.expected_behavior: Each stage alters output signal measurably while limiter caps peaks below 0 dBFS.
features.test_result: Passed: 6/6 FX tests (EQ, Delay, Chorus/Tremolo, Compressor, Reverb, Brickwall Limiter)

features.name: Studio Main Window, Interactive 88/105-Key Keyboard & Dark Theme Controls
features.description: Tauri 2 desktop window with top instrument/preset/morphing bar, dark WebKitGTK select controls, real-time VU/CPU/voice telemetry, interactive 88/105-key piano keyboard, and 7 interactive pedals.
features.expected_behavior: Clicking keys or pressing computer keys plays notes with velocity scaling; active MIDI notes highlight in real time; dark controls remain readable.
features.test_result: Passed: 7/7 tests in tests/ui/app.test.tsx + 16/16 tests in tests/unit/engine_contracts.test.ts

features.name: Interactive Editors (Velocity Curve, 2D Mic Stage, Note Edit, Bounce/NoteFx, MIDI Transport)
features.description: Dedicated visual editors for velocity curve control points, 2D mic stage & binaural head, PRO per-key Note Edit, Mallet Bounce / NoteFx / Harp-Guitar panel, MIDI Transport & CC Learn bar, and user preset saving.
features.expected_behavior: Interactive editors sync bidirectionally with Rust engine state without UI lag.
features.test_result: Passed: 8/8 tests in src/components/StudioComponents.test.tsx + vite build OK

features.name: Complete 215-Parameter LV2 & Manual Capability Extraction
features.description: Structured extraction of all 215 LV2 parameters, 15 groups, 56 instruments, 820 presets, and manual feature descriptions into docs/REFERENCE_PARAMETERS.json.
features.expected_behavior: Every Pianoteq 9.3.1 public parameter and instrument entry is documented with verified evidence.
features.test_result: Passed: json.tool valid, 215 params/15 groups/56 instruments/820 presets verified, validate-features --strict exit 0
